live.title: Bridge
live.owner_words: Connect the separate live Hostinger PHP/HTML/JS billing software to shivaa.in with full automatic two-way sync: website leads/customers/orders/rates/stock -> billing software, and billing customer purchase PDF bills -> customer profile (#/my-bills) + SKU stock; support MySQL + JSON; configure URL/key in Admin Settings; do not deploy without approval.
live.note: Forward release on verified v252 Silk (c78ef0f). Two-way HMAC-SHA256 showroom billing bridge (cms/billing-sync.php + 17 emitters in cms/api.php + lazy-loaded cms/js/admin.js #billingSyncCard + cms/css/v253.css + turnkey billing-connector/shivaa-connector.php & cms/docs/shivaa-connector.php.txt). Website -> Billing: auto-syncs customers, all 9 lead channels and online orders (with paid GST invoiceNo) via post-response DNS-pinned HTTPS webhooks (0 ms shopper impact) + signed pull/catch-up routes (rates, stock, customers, leads, orders, events/ack). Billing -> Website: auto-saves magic-byte-verified purchase PDF bills into private .shivaa-private-bills vault (0600) linked by 10-digit mobile to customer #/my-bills (including pre-signup walk-in mobiles), plus bill void and idempotent SKU stock movements (delta/setStock). Connector supports MySQL + private JSON, shivaa-hooks.php, PHP SDK and authenticated JS bridge. 0 B added to shopper JS; v252 speed & compositor budget preserved.

rules.forward_only: A release number is spent once it is in this ledger. Never renumber, rebuild-to-change, re-ship or revert it. The highest release number is the only truth; any tree below it is history.
rules.deploy: Only the owner deploys, and only after his explicit yes. A push, a merge or a green gate is not approval.
rules.rollback: Rolling back means the PREVIOUS ledger row, never an older tree than live.
rules.guard: Run `bash qa/where-am-i.sh` first in every chat, on any branch. Exit 3 means this tree is behind: stop and move to the release branch it names.

releases.awaiting: the owner's explicit yes — packaged 16 Nov 2026, not installed
releases.note: v250 took the phone's continuous animation away and, with it, every SIGN that the shop is live. v251 gives the sign back out of a budget a phone can spare — transform and opacity, answered by an event, never running on its own. PRESS: every card, tile, chip, tab, drawer row and icon button on a phone answers a tap in 90 ms with scale(.977) on the universal --sx-* rhythm; filter is explicitly removed from the press path (v107 repainted on every press). LIVE: a pending price breathes (opacity only, 1.4 s), the utility strip carries a 6 px live dot, the first row of the grid settles in 24 ms steps travelling 10 px (opacity never changes, so it cannot blink), the bag badge pops for 320 ms when its number changes (MutationObserver on #cartCount/#wishCount), and a fresh rate sweeps one gold hairline (the `rates` event). On a settled page exactly ONE of those is running. POSITION: a 2 px gold read bar, created by the script, filled with transform: scaleX() from one rAF per scroll frame; the page height is measured on resize/route, never inside the scroll handler. FASTER: index.html now loads the MINIFIED build of the one stylesheet — cms/css/shivaa.min.css, 965,451 B -> 876,841 B (-9.2 %; gzip ~191 KB -> 174,636 B) — and tools/build-css-min.mjs REFUSES to write it unless it is structurally identical to the readable bundle (8,758 effective rules compared with their media context, 9 @font-face, 264 @keyframes, csso with restructure:false so no rule is ever merged or moved). Every the app writes carries decoding=async (43 template sites), with a runtime backstop that reports anything a future template forgets. Gates: new qa/browser/t-v251-alive.mjs (46) — 46 + 34 + 36 + 37 suites green, check-handoff green. Instruments: Shivaa.v251.{report,pulses,pop,tick,progress,syncImages}().

releases.title: Bridge
releases.awaiting: the owner's explicit yes — packaged 16 Nov 2026, not installed
releases.note: TWO-WAY BILLING BRIDGE: connects the owner's separate, already-live Hostinger PHP/HTML/JS billing site to shivaa.in (bridge only; dark 403 until configured). WEBSITE -> BILLING: cms/billing-sync.php (SHV_RUN guarded) + cms/api.php auto-emit customer.created/customer.updated (OTP register/login, profile, addresses, Shivaa Black, B2B), lead.created across all 9 channels (contact, service_request, custom_order, metal_exchange, partner_application, savings_plan, rate_alert, abandoned_cart, newsletter) and order.created/order.paid/order.updated (with GST invoiceNo) into durable billingOutbox, delivered post-response after lock release + fastcgi/litespeed_finish_request via SSRF-safe DNS-pinned HTTPS HMAC-SHA256 webhooks (ports 443/8443, no redirects, 0 ms shopper wait), plus signed GET /api/billing/{rates,stock,customers,leads,orders,events} & POST /api/billing/events/ack. BILLING -> WEBSITE: POST /api/billing/bills (JSON base64 or multipart/form-data) verifies %PDF-/image magic bytes, stores 0600 in .shivaa-private-bills outside public_html, normalizes DD/MM/YYYY dates (and fixes bill_clean future-date bug), upserts idempotently by externalId, optionally deducts SKU stock (adjustStock/deductStock), and auto-links by 10-digit mobile to customer #/my-bills (View/Download only, including walk-in customers registering later); plus POST /api/billing/bill-void, DELETE /api/billing/bills/{externalId}, and idempotent single/batch POST /api/billing/stock-movement (delta or setStock). CONNECTOR & ADMIN: billing-connector/shivaa-connector.php (mirrored to cms/docs/shivaa-connector.php.txt for 1-click Admin download) supports MySQL + locked private JSON, seen_deliveries replay guard, shivaa-hooks.php, PHP SDK & staff JS bridge, with billing-connector/CLAUDE-PROMPT-FOR-BILLING-SITE.md and docs/BILLING-SYNC-CONTRACT.md; lazy-loaded admin.js adds #billingSyncCard (URLs, write-only masked key, 5 switches, Test, Backfill, Retry, Download, Copy setup code, activity log) + auto-billing badge in In-store Bills (0 B added to shopper JS). Gates: new qa/browser/t-v253-bridge.mjs (71/71) + t-v229-bills (102/102) + t-v252-silk (48/48) + t-v251 (46/46) + t-v250 (34/34) + t-v249 (36/36) — 337/337 green, phpbal BALANCED x3, CSS proof 8,807 rules, check-handoff 0 red.
